content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: web
          image: web:latest
title: apps/v1/Deployment web

content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: web
spec:
  selector:
    app: web
  ports:
    - port: 80
title: v1/Service web
